chunks: From him, from Yunus, who said:
I asked him about a Jew or a Christian who slanders a follower of a creed from his own creed, and a Magian who slanders a Muslim. He said: “He is flogged with the hadd punishment.”

key_terms.صَاحِبَ مِلَّةٍ: a follower of a religious community or creed
key_terms.يَقْذِفُ: falsely accuses or slanders, especially with an accusation of illicit sexual conduct

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a Jew, Christian, or Magian falsely accuses someone of illicit conduct?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning false accusation or slander involving non-Muslims and Muslims. It indicates that the hadd punishment applies in the case mentioned, reflecting the seriousness of defamatory accusation in Islamic law.
